market_question: Ukraine agrees to limit size of armed forces before 2027?
reasoning: Russia demands demilitarization but Ukraine has consistently refused any limits on its armed forces. A public pledge to cap total personnel would be a major concession requiring a peace deal, which remains unlikely before end-2026 as the war grinds on. Market at 18% overprices this tail risk.
evidence_points: Ukraine's official policy rejects any restrictions on its military size as a sovereign nation.
Negotiations since 2022 have made no progress on demilitarization, and public opinion is strongly against concessions.
Even if a ceasefire emerges, it is more likely to freeze conflict lines without force limits rather than include a cap.
